name: agentic-coding-harness
description: Agent-first walkthroughs and templates for creating detailed harnesses around agentic coding workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Create, review, and refine agent-first coding harnesses.
interface.longDescription: Agent-first walkthroughs, templates, examples, and section-level validation loops for creating, reviewing, and refining repository-specific harnesses with concise agent entry maps, repo-local knowledge systems, inspectable runtime evidence, mechanical enforcement, verification gates, feedback loops, and handoff artifacts for coding agents.
defaultPrompt: Interview me, then create a detailed agentic coding harness for this repository.
Ask me the required scope, boundary, verification, and handoff questions before drafting a coding harness.
Design an agent-first harness with a repo knowledge map, mechanical checks, and feedback loops.
Review this generated coding harness section by section.
Refine this reviewed coding harness until every section is complete.
